    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Shipment_Join" name="Courier requested and products packed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipOrder" name="Ship order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderShipped" name="Order shipped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_StorageManagement" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadToCheck" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckCurrentProductStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckCurrentProductStock" targetRef="Gateway_InStock_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock_Split" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitToRegister" sourceRef="Task_WaitForArrival" targetRef="Task_RegisterArrivedProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PenaltyTrigger" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_DelayOver10Days" targetRef="Task_DemandDelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PenaltyToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DemandDelayPenalty" targetRef="EndEvent_PenaltyDemanded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WithdrawToMerge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_Stock_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterToMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterArrivedProduct" targetRef="Gateway_Stock_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToCheckReady" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock_Merge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReadyToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Shipment_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${orderReady}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderNotReady" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextProductLoop" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckCurrentProductStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_Shipment_Split" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_Shipment_Split" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CourierToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_Shipment_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackToJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_Shipment_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToShip" sourceRef="Gateway_Shipment_Join" targetRef="Task_ShipOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ShipOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderShipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
